lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Luke Murphy is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Luke Murphy is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Luke kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Luke's gone." Elif looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Luke." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Dorothy blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"

d41: At the grave, Henry, Jude, Abdulelah and 7 more speak for Dorothy — "Luke trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Dorothy before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
